description: ModuleFaultCause code set as printed by CMIS 5.0, 5.1 and 5.2: codes 0-3 are defined and 4-31 are Reserved (fault codes). CMIS 5.3 defines codes 4-6 (Transmitter fault, Receiver fault, Temperature related fault); the full latest-revision code set remains CmisModuleFaultCause. This enum is the pre-5.3 window, selected per revision by the field's changed_in rev 5.0 enum_ref override and restored to the full enum by the rev 5.3 entry.

oneOf.description: No fault detected, or the ModuleFaultCause field is not supported
oneOf.title: no_fault_detected_or_field_not_supported
